---
title: L5R Dice Roller
format: dashboard
---

```{r Functions}
library(tidyverse)
N_ROLLS <- 10000

get_rolls <- function(roll) {
  sample(1:10, roll, replace = TRUE)
}

get_keeps <- function(rolls, keep) {
  sort(rolls, decreasing = TRUE)[1:keep]
}

get_bonuses <- function(keeps) {
  n_keeps <- sum(keeps == 10)
  bonuses <- c()
  if (n_keeps == 0) return()
  for (i in 1:n_keeps) {
    bonuses <- c(bonuses, roll_dice(1, 1))
  }
  return(bonuses)
}

roll_dice <- function(roll, keep) {
  rolls <- get_rolls(roll)
  keeps <- get_keeps(rolls, keep)
  bonuses <- get_bonuses(keeps)
  return(c(keeps, bonuses))
}

simulate_rolls <- function(iterations) {
  df <- tibble(.rows = iterations)
  for (r in 1:10) {
    for (k in 1:r) {
      col_name <- paste0("r", r, "k", k)
      rolls <- map_int(1:iterations, ~ sum(roll_dice(r, k)))
      df[col_name] <- rolls
    }
  }
  df <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
    mutate(name = str_remove_all(name, "r")) %>%
    separate(name, into = c("roll", "keep"), sep = "k") %>%
    mutate(across(c(roll, keep), as.integer))
}
```

```{r R Data}
df_ <- simulate_rolls(N_ROLLS)
df_sum <- df_ %>%
  summarise(
    sd = sd(value),
    value = mean(value),
    .by = c(roll, keep)
  )
```

```{r}
# The histogram only needs how often each total came up, so hand OJS the tallies
# instead of every simulated roll. This keeps the JSON embedded in the page small
# no matter how high N_ROLLS goes.
df_counts <- df_ %>%
  count(roll, keep, value, name = "n")

ojs_define(counts = df_counts)
```


## {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
viewof roll = Inputs.select(d3.range(1, 11), {
  label: "Roll",
  value: 7
})
```

```{ojs}
// Keep can never exceed roll, so the options follow the roll selection.
viewof keep = Inputs.select(d3.range(1, roll + 1), {
  label: "Keep",
  value: Math.min(7, roll)
})
```

```{ojs}
// The range has to be positional - Inputs.number ignores min/max passed as options.
viewof target = Inputs.number([0, 200], {
  label: "Target",
  value: 40,
  step: 1
})
```

#### Column {width=60%}

```{ojs}
//| title: Distribution of totals
Plot.plot({
  style: {
    backgroundColor: "transparent",
    color: "#fff",
    fontSize: "13px"
  },
  x: {
    label: "Total rolled",
    labelAnchor: "center",
    tickFormat: "d",
    domain: [0, 150]
  },
  y: {
    label: "Share of rolls",
    tickFormat: ".0%",
    grid: true,
    ticks: 5
  },
  color: {
    domain: ["Below target", "Meets target"],
    range: ["#898781", "#3987e5"],
    legend: true
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(subset, Plot.binX({y: "sum"}, {
      x: "value",
      y: (d) => d.n / stats.n,
      thresholds: bins.thresholds,
      fill: "transparent",
      color: "#888"
    })),
    Plot.areaY(subset, Plot.binX({y: "sum"}, {
      x: "value",
      y: (d) => d.n / stats.n,
      thresholds: bins.thresholds,
      fill: (d) => d.value >= target ? "Meets target" : "Below target",
      fillOpacity: 0.75
    })),
    Plot.lineY(subset, Plot.binX({y: "sum"}, {
      x: "value",
      y: (d) => d.n / stats.n,
      thresholds: bins.thresholds,
      color: "#000"
    })),
    Plot.ruleX([target], {stroke: "currentColor", strokeOpacity: 0.55}),
    Plot.text([`Target ${target}`], {
      x: target,
      frameAnchor: "top",
      textAnchor: "start",
      dx: 5,
      dy: 4,
      fill: "currentColor",
      fillOpacity: 0.72
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "currentColor", strokeOpacity: 0.3})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Only the selected roll/keep pair is plotted.
subset = transpose(counts).filter((d) => +d.roll === roll && +d.keep === keep)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
stats = {
  const rows = subset.slice().sort((a, b) => a.value - b.value);
  const n = d3.sum(rows, (d) => d.n);
  const hits = d3.sum(rows.filter((d) => d.value >= target), (d) => d.n);

  // Weighted median: walk the tallies until half the rolls are behind us.
  let seen = 0;
  let median = NaN;
  for (const row of rows) {
    seen += row.n;
    if (seen >= n / 2) {
      median = row.value;
      break;
    }
  }

  // Each row is a tally, so mean and SD must be weighted by n. d3.deviation
  // would treat every distinct total as a single roll and overweight the tails.
  const mean = n ? d3.sum(rows, (d) => d.value * d.n) / n : NaN;
  const sd = n > 1
    ? Math.sqrt(d3.sum(rows, (d) => d.n * (d.value - mean) ** 2) / (n - 1))
    : NaN;

  return {
    n: n,
    hits: hits,
    p: n ? hits / n : 0,
    mean: mean,
    sd: sd,
    median: median,
    min: rows.length ? rows[0].value : NaN,
    max: rows.length ? rows[rows.length - 1].value : NaN
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Bin edges are anchored on the target so no bar straddles it: every bar is
// wholly below the target or wholly at/above it, which is what the fill colour
// claims.
bins = {
  const width = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((stats.max - stats.min + 1) / 36));
  const start = target - Math.ceil((target - stats.min) / width) * width;
  return {
    width: width,
    thresholds: d3.range(start, stats.max + width + 1, width)
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Follows Quarto's light/dark toggle so the hover tip matches the card.
darkMode = Generators.observe((notify) => {
  const read = () => notify(document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark"));
  const observer = new MutationObserver(read);
  read();
  observer.observe(document.body, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"]});
  return () => observer.disconnect();
})
```

#### Column {width=40%}
```{r}
#| title: Average Dice Rolls
#| dev: "png"
#| dev.args: !expr list(bg = "transparent")
#| message: false
df_sum %>%
  mutate(text_color = ifelse(value > 50, "black", "white")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = roll, y = keep, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = signif(value, 3), color = text_color)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:10, expand = c(0, 0), position = "right") +
  # coord_equal() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "F") +
  scale_color_identity() +
  labs(
    x = "Roll",
    y = "Keep",
    fill = "Average Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "white"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
#| title: Improving Rolls vs. Keeps
#| dev: "png"
#| dev.args: !expr list(bg = "transparent")
#| message: false
df_sum %>%
  pivot_longer(c(roll, keep), values_to = "axis") %>%
  arrange(axis) %>%
  ggplot(aes(axis, value, color = name, fill=name)) +
  geom_smooth(se = F) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.5, jitter.width = 0.1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  labs(
    x = "Value",
    y = "Average Value",
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color="white"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.1, 0.9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "transparent"),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank()
  )
```
